name: Equation4_implies_Equation43
statement: theorem Equation4_implies_Equation43 (G: Type*) [Magma G] (h: Equation387 G) : Equation43 G
proof:
:= by
  have idem (x : G) : (x ∘ x) ∘ (x ∘ x) = (x ∘ x) := by
    rw [<-h, <-h]
  have comm (x y : G) : (x ∘ x) ∘ y = y ∘ (x ∘ x) := by
    rw [<-idem, <-h, idem]
  have op_idem (x y : G) : (x ∘ x) ∘ (y ∘ y) = x ∘ y := by
    rw [<-h, <-h]
  intro x y
  rw [<- op_idem, comm, op_idem]

name: Equation46_not_implies_Equation3
statement: theorem Equation46_not_implies_Equation3 : ∃ (G: Type) (_: Magma G), Equation46 G ∧ ¬ Equation4 G
proof:
:= by
  let hG : Magma Nat := {
    op := fun _ _ => 0
  }
  use ℕ, hG
  constructor
  . intro _ _ _ _
    rfl
  by_contra h
  replace h := h 1 0
  dsimp [hG] at h
  linarith
